d: The Detroit Pistons overcame a 22-point deficit to defeat the Boston Celtics, 121-113, in their season opener. Jalen Duren led Detroit with 22 points and nine rebounds, while Cade Cunningham added 22 points, four rebounds, and eight assists. Duncan Robinson contributed 21 points, including 15 in the fourth quarter, and knocked down five three-pointers. Paul George paced Boston with 38 points, seven three-pointers, five rebounds, three assists, and five steals, while Derrick White added 17 points and eight assists in the loss.
